finding: NEEDS_SOURCE — craft options that cannot be generated faithfully because the authoritative drawing does not exist or is provably wrong.
principle: Tech packs are law. Where no drawing exists, the option is NOT generated and NOT guessed. Each entry below names exactly what must be supplied.

A_no_illustration_at_all.description: In-scope option rows with illustration=null. 162 rows collapse to these distinct identities (keyed part|field|option|label).

B_amf_stitching_no_authentic_artwork.description: The catalog sells AMF (hand-picked) stitching as distinct from machine TOP stitching, but no authentic AMF drawing exists anywhere in the repo.
B_amf_stitching_no_authentic_artwork.evidence_verified_2026_07_30: md5 of public/images/decoration_stitching_on_cuff/: machine-01cm-amf == machine-01cm-top (9a634c7a8120); machine-03cm-amf == machine-03cm-top (550a2d999842); machine-05cm-amf == machine-05cm-top (e0700432aa6a). Every -amf file is a byte-identical copy of its same-cm -top file.
B_amf_stitching_no_authentic_artwork.required: Supplier line drawings showing genuine AMF/pick stitching (visibly hand-worked, irregular pick spacing) at 0.1 / 0.3 / 0.5 / 0.6 cm, distinct from machine top stitching.
B_amf_stitching_no_authentic_artwork.until_then: These options must NOT be generated. An AMF photo derived from a TOP drawing would be a fabricated distinction sold to a customer.

C_collar_stitching_filenames_misdescribe.description: In public/images/decoration_stitching_on_collar/ the filenames do not match what the drawings actually depict. Binding by filename yields the wrong drawing.

evidence_verified_2026_07_30.stray: machine-05cm-amf-stitching.jpg (debee267582e) carries NO callout and shows a bright-red zigzag edge stitch — likely belongs to the zigzag collar option, not this ladder.

C_collar_stitching_filenames_misdescribe.action_already_taken: The 8 TOP options were bound by ANNOTATION (blueprint law over filename). The 6 AMF options were routed to needs-source.
C_collar_stitching_filenames_misdescribe.required: A human decision to RENAME the files on disk to match their annotated contents. Not done autonomously because renaming supplier assets is a destructive, human-owned call.

D_loops_5.description: belt-loops / loops-5 ("5 Loops") has no blueprint and currently displays the 7-loop photo. This is the SHIPPED_IMAGE_REUSED blocking finding.
D_loops_5.required: A supplier drawing showing a 5-loop belt-loop layout.
D_loops_5.until_then: Do not guess a loop count. Route to needs-source.
